phone.notes: New: Domains also open by themselves in the zones of the world (their boss has lives and, if nobody beats it in time, it breaks and attacks a city), boosts for everybody when a Domain boss falls, a new Digi-Beetle inventory with a backpack, every chest opens, wild Digimon scale with your team and more fixes. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Fix: the steps of an adventure count again. The walk could stay at 0 / 1000 while encounters kept coming, because it used a rough accelerometer guess if you started it right after opening the app. It now always uses the step counter of the watch.
